post_quantize_model_fx: use PostQuantizationFX to prepare, calibrate, and convert a PyTorch model with FX graph mode quantization
post_quantize_model_graph: use PostQuantizationGraph to trace, calibrate, and convert a PyTorch model with graph mode quantization
post_quantize_model_eager: use PostQuantization to fuse batch norm, add quant stubs, calibrate, and convert a model in eager mode
quantize_model_helper: use quantize_model to build, fuse, prepare, calibrate, and convert a model from a builder callable in one step
get_qconfig_dict: use get_qconfig_dict to recursively build a qconfig dictionary from a module for FX quantization
